inj.note: Ioane suffered a sprained MCL in his right knee in Week 7 versus the Bengals, and he was initially expected to miss time. It now looks possible that he could be available as soon as this Sunday versus the Bills, but he will receive an official injury designation after Friday's final practice of the week.

news.h: Sources: Ravens rookie G Olaivavega Ioane expected to miss time with MCL sprain
news.d: Ravens rookie guard Olaivavega Ioane is expected to miss time after spraining his MCL in Sunday's loss to the Bengals.
